assisted.priority: Best plausible output using model-specific prompts and reference preparation.
assisted.palette: Lavender and purple dress, maroon and gold male costume, warm skin and green garden.
assisted.cuts: Visually verified source boundaries in scene_manifest.json.
assisted.inspection: Prompt/reference revision is allowed and must be recorded.

automatic.priority: One CLI launch from the original source, with no reference selection or palette editing by the operator.
automatic.ltx: Fixed generic prompt, seed 42, continuous native chunks across the full clip.
automatic.havc: Author edge detector, paired author DiT reference generation, sliding 20-reference CMNET2 memory and author propagation size.
automatic.inspection: Judge the first completed output. Technical setup failures are recorded separately and do not authorize quality tuning.

shared_setup.machine: M3 Ultra, 60 GPU cores, 256 GiB unified memory
shared_setup.concurrency: One experiment GPU worker at a time, enforced by a file lock.
shared_setup.memory: Backend allocation caps plus a supervisor that terminates its worker on low system headroom or swap growth.
shared_setup.compatibility_gates: Short trained-model runs before case launches; gates are not scored as full-clip results.
shared_setup.comparison: Visual color plausibility, temporal stability, identity/detail preservation and runtime. No ground-truth color exists for this clip.
